verdict.rationale: Radar rules explicitly support triggering 3DS for risky payments (e.g., new customers) and blocking based on location, showing conditional SCA-related risk logic, but the evidence never mentions automatic exemption requests (e.g., low-risk/TRA exemptions) for safe transactions — that logic is not documented as part of Radar. missing for 10: explicit SCA exemption-request mechanism, evidence of EU-specific compliance handling, independent confirmation of exemption behavior.
